_meta.description: Tom is a free, open-source music machine: dial in a melody in seconds, snap a song together like Lego, or tune in to endless radio. Royalty-free, and it all runs on your device.
add-tom-to-your.59ef0c: Add Tom to your Home Screen and it opens like an app, with or without a connection.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
can-i-use-tom.f6a069: Can I use Tom's music in my videos and apps?
dial-in-a-melody.b34016: Dial in a melody, snap a song together like Lego, or tune in to endless radio. Royalty-free, and it all runs in your browser.
drop-intro-verse-chorus.81dd17: Drop intro, verse, chorus and ending blocks on a timeline, or let Auto build, finish or re-roll whatever you haven't locked.
every-note-comes-from.db74fd: Every note comes from a seed, so the same seed always makes the same music.
pick-a-station-and.5f19f1: Pick a station and Tom writes an endless run of new songs. On iPhone it keeps playing with the screen locked.
pick-a-style-key.0f911c: Pick a style, key, tempo, swing and shape, and Tom writes the melody. Turning a dial keeps the seed, so you shape it instead of starting over.
the-composer-colored-song.b5c3a3: The Composer: colored song blocks arranged on a timeline
the-melody-machine-a.4ad90b: The Melody Machine: a piano roll above style, key, tempo and shape controls
the-same-engine-runs.ff460c: The same engine runs in Node: render WAV and MIDI from a seed, or score a Monkr video with a jingle that lands on the beat.
tom-radio-a-grid.036808: Tom Radio: a grid of stations, from Synthwave to Country
tom-writes-every-note.c89000: Tom writes every note itself, so there's nothing to license and nothing to get flagged. A share link's hashtag is the whole song.
wav-audio-midi-for.f3ae6e: WAV audio, MIDI for your music software, and a song file you can open again later. A share link carries the whole song in its hashtag.
yes-a-radio-start.6cb191: Yes. A radio start link opens a station and plays it. Put it in a Shortcut's Open URLs action and ask Siri; iOS needs one tap before a web page can play sound.
yes-everything-renders-in.b80924: Yes. Everything renders in your browser. After your first visit Tom works offline, and on iPhone or iPad you can add it to your Home Screen.
yes-tom-writes-every.aed212: Yes. Tom writes every note itself from a seed, with no samples, so what you make is yours to use, royalty-free.
